name: How much space is needed in a shower to comfortably fit a built-in bench?

mainEntity.name: How much space is needed in a shower to comfortably fit a built-in bench?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom built-in bench generally requires a shower footprint of at least 36 by 48 inches, or ideally 42 by 60 inches, to prevent the seat from crowding your standing area. In smaller three-wall enclosures or standard 30-by-60-inch tub-to-shower conversions, a deep built-in bench can make moving around difficult. For tighter layouts, practical alternatives include a compact triangular corner seat, a narrow floating ledge for shaving, or a wall-mounted fold-down bench that folds flat when not in use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Showers should ideally be at least 36 by 48 inches for a built-in bench; smaller showers often work better with a compact corner seat or fold-down bench.
